scope: Retrospective paired diagnostic of all 64 previously published clouds. Same selected support, scale, fields, moment constraints and minimum-variance objective. True simulator geometry is used only in the oracle. No new independent evidence, new support search, trained correction, production change, or asymptotic convergence claim.
decomposition: e_actual=d+r, d=B_true f-Lf, r=(B_actual-B_true)f. MSE_actual=E[d^2]+E[r^2]+2E[d*r]. The signed cross term is mandatory. Metadata: e_meta=d+r_base+c, c=(B_meta-B_base)f, with all three cross terms.
taylor: Exact field split into degree-one Taylor term, degree-two term and the full remainder. Report each response, all cross terms and physical moment residuals. Oracle low-degree residuals are numerical; the remainder is the finite-stencil discretization residual conditional on the fixed selected support.
decision: DECOMPOSITION_VERIFIED only if all 64 scheduled records are preserved, every previously complete cloud has a certified full-rank oracle, frozen original/projected weights replay, independent whitened-SVD weights agree, polynomial/Taylor/MSE identities pass, input/source hashes verify and execution fits the fixed budget. Otherwise DECOMPOSITION_HOLD. A descriptive geometric-leverage screen additionally requires oracle/original RMSE <0.5 and upper paired-cloud bootstrap ratio <1; it is not a confirmatory test or permission to remove any existing HOLD.
failures: No replacements or truth-based support reselection. Unavailable old supports remain unavailable; oracle failures are preserved and prevent DECOMPOSITION_VERIFIED. No numerical threshold changes after results.
